author: worker_2
belief: The heaviest animal in the world is the Blue Whale (Balaenoptera musculus), with an average mass of 110 tonnes and maximum recorded weight of 190 tonnes.

author: worker_2
belief: Blue whales live in oceans worldwide, not specifically in Africa. They are found in all major oceans.

author: worker_2
belief: The top 5 heaviest animals are: 1) Blue whale, 2) North Pacific right whale, 3) Southern right whale, 4) Fin whale, 5) Bowhead whale - all are marine mammals (whales).

author: worker_2
belief: None of the top 5 heaviest animals (all whales) live in Africa; they are all marine animals found in oceans worldwide.

author: worker_3
belief: The North Pacific right whale (second heaviest animal) lives in the North Pacific Ocean (Bering Sea, Gulf of Alaska, Sea of Okhotsk, around Japan and Russia), NOT in Africa.

author: worker_4
belief: Southern right whales live in the Southern Hemisphere and migrate to coastal waters of South Africa, Namibia, and Mozambique. They DO live in Africa.

author: worker_4
belief: Fin whales are found in all major oceans worldwide, including waters around Africa. They DO live in Africa.

author: worker_4
belief: Bowhead whales are endemic to Arctic and subarctic waters only. They do NOT live in Africa.
